flags.quote: none of the entry team searched for weapons
flags.explanation: Potential issue with the presumption of innocence. The entry team frisked the defendants on their beds and declared the room clear without seeing any weapons; after the defendants had been taken out for several minutes, the search team described a firearm and a grenade as very obvious. The lawyer may want to assess whether this account of the discovery meets the prosecution's burden of proof.
questions_for_lawyer: Does the prosecution's account explain why the entry team did not see the weapons?
Did the court place the burden of proof on the defendant?
missing_facts: Who stayed in the room while the defendants were outside, and was that time recorded?
Was the search filmed or witnessed by anyone independent of the police and military?
What prompted the decision to carry out the raid that night?
